about: RFC 8785 kernel fixture for #311, written before any encoder existed. Each record's canonical bytes (UTF-8 of 'canonical') and SHA-256 were computed by two independent throwaway encoders outside the repo (a Python one: keys sorted by their UTF-16-BE bytes, numbers by ECMA-262 Number::toString over repr's shortest digits; and a Node one: Object.keys().sort() and JSON.stringify), which agreed on every record. 'input' is the record as a JSON text, keys out of order and with whitespace.
